traits.leaf_arrangement.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): Santalaceae usually opposite, or alternate; Viscaceae (now in Santalaceae) opposite; Loranthaceae usually opposite; Olacaceae alternate. Weighting by species (mistletoes dominate); inferred. APweb gives no order-level state.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Follows the leaf arrangement: opposite pairs in Santalaceae/Viscaceae/Loranthaceae (decussate inferred from opposite pairs); DELTA Olacaceae alternate, commonly two-ranked or spiral.

traits.leaf_division.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): Santalaceae, Viscaceae, Loranthaceae leaves simple and entire; APweb Santalales page: lamina margins entire.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): Santalaceae, Viscaceae, Olacaceae regular; Loranthaceae regular to somewhat irregular.

traits.flower_merosity.note: Replaces the Pentapetalae value. DELTA (read 2026-10-16): Santalaceae usually 4-5 (3-8); Viscaceae 3-4; Loranthaceae mostly 5-6 (to 9); Olacaceae 3-5 (APweb: 3-6).

traits.stamens.note: APweb, Santalales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): stamens opposite the petals (so as many as they are). DELTA: Loranthaceae 5-6; Santalaceae 4-5; Viscaceae usually 4; Olacaceae 3-18.

traits.carpels.note: APweb, Santalales page (read 2026-10-16): gynoecium of three fused carpels at order level. DELTA: Santalaceae 2-5 (usually 3); Viscaceae 3-4; Olacaceae (2-)3(-5).

traits.ovary_position.note: APweb, Santalales page (read 2026-10-16): many taxa in the early families have a superior ovary; inferior ovaries arose in the parasitic clade. DELTA: Santalaceae partly inferior to inferior, Viscaceae and Loranthaceae inferior, Olacaceae usually superior. 'Usually inferior' by species weight.

traits.fruit_type.note: APweb, Santalales page (read 2026-10-16): fruit a one-seeded drupe. DELTA: Viscaceae berry; Loranthaceae berry or drupe; Santalaceae and Olacaceae drupe or nut.

traits.inflorescence.note: APweb, Santalales page (read 2026-10-16): inflorescences cymose. DELTA: Loranthaceae cymose units often in threes; Viscaceae small cymes in spikes.

traits.sexual_system.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): Loranthaceae mostly hermaphrodite; Olacaceae and Santalaceae hermaphrodite, monoecious or dioecious; Viscaceae always unisexual (override on Santalaceae).

traits.leaf_habit.note: DELTA Loranthaceae (read 2026-10-16): evergreen, leathery leaves; mistletoes of Santalaceae (Viscum, Phoradendron) likewise persistent. Partly inferred for Santalaceae and Olacaceae (tropical woody plants).

traits.life_span.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): Loranthaceae, Viscaceae, Olacaceae woody; Santalaceae trees, shrubs or herbs; Balanophoraceae annual to perennial.

traits.rosette.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): woody hemiparasites and trees; no rosettes described.
